simple.summary: קֶרֶן הַפּוּךְ (qeren hap-pûwk) means Keren-hap-Puk , one of Job's daughters First listed occurrence: Job 42 14.

definitions.full: H7163. qeren hap-puwk הַמּוּךְ קֶרֶן proper name, feminine ( horn of antimony , i.e. beautifier , see מּוּח ); — Job's third daughter Job 42:14 .
